title: [3.0-beta11] Ruffy driver disappears (DeadObjectException)
symptom: Once a day, the Ruffy driver disappears from AndroidAPS, causing a DeadObjectException when trying to connect to the pump. The user reports the issue on a Jelly 2 smartphone with Android 11, and it happens despite following hints from a related issue.
evidence_quote: I get always DeadObjectException once a day.
